title: Chic Urban Getaway
description:
A convenient and contemporary space that offers up a spacious layout and a fabulous location, that's only 1.5 miles from Downtown and .3 miles to the Nashville Soccer Stadium, (so close you can walk)! You'll love the comfort and ease of this darling rental!

Comes with 2 parking spots

The space
Main Floor - kitchen, living area, guest bedroom with king bed, bathroom with walk in shower and two sinks, and powder room.
Second Floor - two guest bedrooms with queen beds, bathroom with shower tub combo, and common space with full size futon.

Other things to note
There is 2 parking space available next to the building, with a permit. Street parking is first-come, first-serve for all other vehicles
